levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Final summary still contains shame or self-critical language.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Final summary is entirely in fact language.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Final summary is in fact language and explicitly separates what happened from who the learner is.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Forward plan is vague, for example 'do better.'

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Forward plan names one specific thing to carry forward.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Forward plan names a specific thing and ties it to the specific step or moment it came from.

lookFors: No shame or self-critical words appear in the final written summary.
Summary includes both something that went well and something that didn't, not just one.
Forward-looking reflection is concrete enough to actually check next time.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
